title: Customer Invoice Payments Booked as New Sales
what_raw_ai_does_wrong: When a customer pays an open invoice by check or ACH into a parent or operating bank account, raw AI books it as new Sales Revenue instead of matching Accounts Receivable.
real_smb_dollar_example: Case 1 ($84,250 wholesale customer ACH into parent company for a sister cafe's invoice) and Case 2 ($28,400 commercial roofing check booked to Sales).
how_level_playbooks_and_cpas_fix_it: Cross-checks every deposit amount and memo against open customer invoices across all related entities before recording revenue.

title: Intercompany Transfers & Loans Booked as Income

how_level_playbooks_and_cpas_fix_it: Matches transfers across sister-company bank statements and routes capital inflows over $5,000 to loan or equity accounts.
